and watching it i realized the whole fight was a live demo of something i wrote down as an axiom this week

axiom 1 emotion direction: every emotion is an internal response that directs energy toward or away from a target and the target and direction are what give the emotion its name

the ravens threw every bit of their energy straight AT the buzzard

meanwhile the buzzard folded its wings and dropped behind the rooftops with all of its energy going away from them

same sky and the same thirty seconds and two completely different emotions running on each side

the axiom put every emotion inside the one responding so the event itself carried zero emotion

the emotion lived entirely in which way each animal was moving relative to the other

the axiom said every emotion so it covered people the exact same way

hand two guys the same harsh comment and one of them walks straight back into the conversation to argue the point while the other one stops replying for a week

the comment was identical and the direction split them

so when someone says a situation made them angry the situation is the wrong place to look

find the target and find which way the energy went

the phone version needs to be designed as its own thing with fewer columns and a shorter headline and the button pulled up to where the thumb already sits

when i build a website the phone layout gets its own grid and its own section order before anyone approves anything

11178972.originalText:
your website only needs THREE colors and the one you fought hardest over matters the least

somebody charged you weeks of back and forth to pick that brand color

here is why it barely matters

you can have a sharp logo and a real photo of yourself and copy that says exactly what you do

but if the visitor has no idea which color means click

the page just sits there looking nice while they leave

most owners believe more colors means more personality

bullshit

every color on the page is telling the visitor what to do and most websites are shouting ten instructions at once

here is the breakdown in order of importance

THE THREE COLOR JOBS:

#1 - THE ACCENT COLOR
most important

the one color that only ever shows up on buttons and links you want clicked

spray it everywhere and the buttons disappear into the decoration

keep it on actions only and the visitor finds the next button before reading a word

WHY IT MATTERS:
people learn the pattern on the first screen

they spot the orange button in the hero and by the second section their eye is already hunting for orange

every time orange shows up on an icon or a heading underline or a divider that hunt breaks and the eye bounces between ten orange things that do nothing

so the accent works like a sign that says click here and every icon you paint orange is a fake sign

#2 - THE NEUTRALS
underrated

the white or off white backgrounds and the dark text that cover most of the page

muddy backgrounds give the accent nothing to pop against

a calm background with near black text makes the one orange button jump off the screen

WHY IT MATTERS:
contrast only exists relative to whatever sits around it

light grey body text on white makes people squint and the ai builder loves shipping exactly that because it looks soft in a screenshot

a busy patterned background steals the attention the button was supposed to get

so the neutrals decide whether your accent is visible at all

#3 - THE BRAND COLOR
least important

the color from your logo that goes on headings and a section background or two

everyone overrates it because they stared at the logo for weeks

the visitor glances at it for a second to recognize they landed on the right business and then goes looking for the button

THE MORE COLORS MYTH:
a fourth color earns a spot only when it has a job the other three can not do

the cheap agency that hands you a brand guide with nine swatches and a gradient for every mood gave you a rainbow template and called it identity

SO HOW DO YOU APPLY THIS:

FOR THE ACCENT:
- pick one color that appears nowhere in your logo or photos
- put it on every button and link you want clicked and strip it from everything else
- make every button solid with white or dark text inside so it reads at a glance

FOR THE NEUTRALS:
- keep most of the page on one background color
- set body text close to black

FOR THE BRAND COLOR:
- use it for the logo and headings and one section background at most

then scroll your homepage and count every spot the accent color shows up

if that number is bigger than your number of buttons you found the leak

aka the cheapest fix on your whole website

11178973.originalText:
why did two magpies on a fence jump out at me from a moving bus while every house on that street vanished

i ride that exact route twice a day

months ago my brain filed the houses and the corners and the shop signs as already seen and quit looking

the two magpies sitting on the fence of the table tennis court on the corner were new so they were the only thing that registered

your homepage gets read the exact same way

the keep everything consistent advice that every template and every ai builder pushes is half right and the half it gets wrong is why nobody reaches your price

here is the nuance you are missing

keep the rules identical all the way down the page

the spacing and the fonts and the colors stay the same everywhere

change the shape of the sections as you go

every new section gets a new layout because the visitor is asking a new question by then

let me explain

if you stack the same three column block with an icon and a heading and two lines of text five times down the page the brain predicts the whole page from the second one

it decided it already saw the ending

so it skims and scrolls hunting for anything different and bails before your offer shows up which is the whole fucking point of the page

brains are constantly guessing how a story ends and a repeated layout tells them the story already ended

but if each section changes shape at the moment the question of the visitor changes while the rules underneath stay steady and every change has a reason behind it

the brain has to keep paying attention just to keep up

for example here is how the shapes follow the questions

1. the problem
one big sentence about their problem sitting alone with a lot of space around it because a person reading their own pain needs a second to nod

2. the fix
a real photo of you working on one side and your steps on the other because now they want to know how

3. the proof
a row of real faces with full names and what each person got because the next question in their head is who else paid this guy

4. the next step
one centered box with one solid button and a lot of space around it because the only thing left to decide is what to do now

now the warning

change with zero reason is just chaos

the nephew who built your website over a weekend put a different background and a new animation and a random slider in every section because he could and the visitor was seasick by the third scroll

the real issue with consistency advice is where people apply it

they make the services a card grid and the testimonials a card grid and the team a card grid and call that a design system

take that same content and turn the services into a numbered list and the testimonials into one big quote with a face next to it and the team into one wide photo and the exact same words suddenly get read

anyways two more magpies showed up on the grass eight minutes later and i clocked those too
